verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an AI model platform with user accounts and API usage, but the evidence pack documents no data-export feature. The OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API formats and the downloadable open weights make switching providers easier, but they are adjacent portability features. They are not an export of the user's own data in open formats, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
